description: Evidence-led research for any domain: compare options, review literature, diagnose failures, and analyze markets with exploratory, descriptive, and historical causal workflows.

defaultPrompt: Compare products in this category against my constraints and show the evidence.
Summarize the PubMed evidence on this question, with study design and sample size.
What public filings explain this market move; stay within safe and lawful public sources.
interface.longDescription: A portable research workflow for products, scientific literature, device failures, markets, and technology. Source verification, causal discipline, implementation and action-plan handoffs, and Karpathy-inspired working principles. Responds in the language of the research request.

name: research-plugin
